sacrebleu does — otherwise one empty share would make the whole score

text.tspan: BLEU beside it: partial credit for every matching run of words
The BLEU numbers are the notebook’s
Answers are now graded with partial credit as well as all-or-nothing. On the trained model both

sequence B — "the cat is sleeping on the sofa" (no padding — it sets the width)
Two kinds of numbers, always labelled. TRAINED numbers come from running the
